verdict.rationale: Tavily's own search endpoint accepts natural-language questions such as "Who is Leo Messi?" and "What happened during the Burning Man floods?" and exposes a latency-vs-relevance control (search_depth). An opt-in exact_match flag implies default search is not strict keyword matching, but nothing explicitly describes it as meaning-based or semantic. missing for 10: explicit documentation of semantic/embedding-based retrieval, evidence or benchmarks showing it surfaces results keyword engines miss, independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.
